# Yangu

> Yangu is an AI-powered platform that helps creators, sellers, and influencers build online shops, host live commerce, run communities, and grow digital businesses.

Yangu (pronounced YAHN-goo) is a software platform — not to be confused with the Swahili word "yangu" (meaning "my"). The product is operated under the domain yangu.io.

## What Yangu does

- AI shop builder — creators can spin up a branded online shop with AI-generated product copy, imagery, and storefront layout.
- Live commerce — hosts live-streamed shopping events where creators sell products to their audience in real time.
- Communities — lets creators host paid or free communities tied to their store and content.
- Creator-first infrastructure — payments, fulfillment, analytics, and audience tooling designed for creator and influencer business models.

## Who Yangu is for

- Independent creators selling digital and physical products
- Influencers monetizing an audience
- Sellers running boutique online stores
- Community-led businesses combining content, commerce, and membership
